products.product_description: Nature's Plus GLUTEN Free SPIRU-TEIN HIGH PROTEIN ENERGY MEAL, S'mores (Flavor), 1.2 OZ. (34g) Packet, Display Box Product No. 95903, Individual Packet Product No. 45905, UPC Code 097467459052. There are 8 foil packets per corrugated display box. --- Serving Size - 1 packet (1.2 oz.).
products.reason_for_recall: One lot of 1.2 oz. packets of Spiru-tein High Protein Energy Meal, S'mores flavor, is labeled as "Gluten Free" but actually contains gluten. Lot 1243522 of the product with Best Buy Date 06 2016 is being recalled.
